visualHierarchyIssues: Ensure Arabic typography (IBM Plex Sans Arabic) maintains consistent baseline line-height (leading-relaxed) across responsive cards.
uxHeuristics: Primary action CTAs in modals and forms should display explicit visual loading spinners (RefreshCw spin) to prevent duplicate submissions.

actionableFixes.issue: Arabic text clipping or uneven line spacing in dense data cards
actionableFixes.fix: Enforce font-feature-settings: "cv01", "ss01" and line-height: 1.6 for Arabic body copy

actionableFixes.issue: Disbursement submit button needs active disabled feedback
actionableFixes.fix: Add disabled={isSubmitting} and inline spinner state with aria-busy="true"
